cache_config:
import base from "./vite.config";
export default { ...base, cacheDir: "{AUTHORING_VITE_CACHE}", test: { ...(base as any).test, cache: false } };

{AUTHORING_CHECKOUT}.meaning: Historical authoring repository checkout; suffixes are repository-relative. Exact machine root is retained in the raw record at the indicated locations.

{AUTHORING_VITE_CACHE}.meaning: Historical external Vite cache directory; exact value is retained at the indicated raw record locations.

_portability.hash_semantics: All pre-existing hashes and empirical values are unchanged and refer to original captured bytes/candidates, never this portable view. For rewritten referenced records use CUSTODY.json original-to-raw mapping; no rerun or re-observation is implied. JSON pointer locations address original raw values; key: denotes a dictionary key.
